variance_surface_label: Example State official voter-information request-context variance policy
delivery_role_note: Variant review keeps the same official voter-information URL from quietly telling different voters different things because of cookie state, edge rules, experiments, or inferred geography, but it does not replace content correctness, language-access review, or the current office/help lane as the authority source.
variant_policy_note: The office distinguishes visible user-chosen variants from ambient context-driven variants and does not let hidden edge or experiment logic silently rewrite critical public answers.
no_cookie_first_visit_note: The no-cookie and first-visit path remains authoritative for critical public answers so crawlers and privacy-hardened clients do not fall into a weaker or placeholder shell.
user_choice_persistence_note: When the voter explicitly chooses language or jurisdiction, the chosen variant is preserved visibly rather than being silently overridden by fresh ambient inference.
vary_header_note: When request headers influence the response, the office records the affected dimensions and uses a stable variance declaration posture so cache and diagnosis do not guess.
experiment_boundary_note: A/B testing and personalization are limited to non-authoritative presentation elements and do not change action-controlling answer semantics.
crawler_visibility_note: Crawler-visible variants are reviewed alongside human no-cookie paths so discovery diagnosis does not assume the same bytes that a cookied user saw.
fallback_help_note: All variants preserve a direct official help/contact lane and current notice path when context inference is ambiguous or wrong.
